req.title: Reject non-positive redirect count
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the redirect count is zero or negative.

doc.reasoning: The violation is test[4] (test_redirect_large_negative_returns_error) which has kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative kind tests use heuristic=NEG (not EP). EP is reserved for positive equivalence partition tests. Fix: change heuristic from EP to NEG for that test. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_redirect_positive_n_returns_302
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n=1 is a valid positive redirect count
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: positive path — n=1 satisfies n>0, redirect issued
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_positive_n_returns_302():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/get' in location

test_redirect_positive_n_returns_302()

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_returns_error
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n=0 is the exact boundary value that must be rejected
expected: HTTP response is NOT 2xx (must be 400 or 500, not 200/302)
Status code is exactly 400 per requirement R-HTTPBIN-023
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: boundary — n=0 is the exact zero boundary, must be rejected with 400
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_zero_returns_error():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code >= 400
    assert r.status_code < 600

test_redirect_zero_returns_error()

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_not_success_and_not_redirect
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n=0 is the exact zero boundary
actions: Create test client with TESTING=False to get real error codes
expected: Status code is in error range (>=400)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: BVA exact zero — catches off-by-one mutation n>0 -> n>=0 or n>-1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_redirect_zero_not_success_and_not_redirect():
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code not in (200, 201, 204, 301, 302, 303, 307, 308)
        assert r.status_code >= 400

test_redirect_zero_not_success_and_not_redirect()

def test_redirect_n2_returns_302_positive_partition():
